## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reasonably small.
- [ ] Code follows the existing style (TypeScript, ESM, no new heavy deps).
- [ ] Added/updated tests where it makes sense.

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data in the diff.
